senses.en: a valuable old object, such as furniture or jewelry
old and valuable because of age or quality

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her letters in an antique wooden desk.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把信件放在一張古董木桌裡。

root.note: 屬於從前的 → 古董

senses.en: a substance that kills germs and prevents infection
preventing infection; extremely clean
lacking warmth or character

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with an antiseptic before bandaging it.
ex.zh: 護士先用消毒劑清理傷口，再包紮起來。

root.note: 對抗腐爛的 → 抗菌的

senses.en: opposed to slavery

ex.en: Frederick Douglass became a powerful antislavery speaker.
ex.zh: 腓德烈克・道格拉斯成為一位強而有力的反奴隸制度演說家。

root.note: 反對奴隸制度的

senses.en: a drug that relieves muscle spasms
relieving spasms of the muscles

ex.en: The doctor prescribed an antispasmodic for her stomach cramps.
ex.zh: 醫生開了解痙攣藥來治她的胃痙攣。

root.note: 對抗痙攣的

senses.en: the second section of a Greek choral ode, answering the first (the strophe)
senses.zh: （希臘合唱頌歌的）第二節；回舞歌

ex.en: The chorus moved back across the stage as they sang the antistrophe.
ex.zh: 合唱隊一邊唱回舞歌，一邊走回舞台另一側。

root.note: 反方向轉回來時唱的段落 → 回舞歌

senses.en: an antibody that neutralizes a specific toxin

ex.en: The patient received an antitoxin to fight the snake venom.
ex.zh: 病人注射了抗毒素來對抗蛇毒。

root.note: 對抗毒素的物質

senses.en: a word opposite in meaning to another

ex.en: "Cold" is the antonym of "hot."
ex.zh: cold 是 hot 的反義詞。

root.note: 意思相反的字 → 反義詞

senses.en: worried or nervous about something uncertain
eager or strongly wanting to do something

ex.en: He felt anxious while waiting for his test results.
ex.zh: 他在等考試成績時感到很焦慮。

root.note: 心被勒緊 → 焦慮的

senses.en: lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern

ex.en: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in decades.
ex.zh: 選民的冷漠導致數十年來最低的投票率。

root.note: 沒有感覺 → 冷漠

senses.en: an opening, hole, or gap
the adjustable opening in a camera that lets in light

ex.en: Light entered the dark room through a small aperture in the wall.
ex.zh: 光線從牆上的一個小孔照進暗房。

root.note: 打開的地方 → 孔

senses.en: the top or highest point of something

ex.en: At the apex of her career, she was the most famous actress in the country.
ex.zh: 在事業巔峰時，她是全國最有名的女演員。

senses.en: a short, clever saying that expresses a general truth

ex.en: "Less is more" is a popular aphorism among designers.
ex.zh: 「少即是多」是設計師之間常說的格言。

root.note: 劃清界限、下定義的話 → 格言

senses.en: a place where bees are kept

ex.en: The farm has a small apiary that produces honey every summer.
ex.zh: 這座農場有個小型養蜂場，每年夏天都產蜂蜜。

root.note: 養蜜蜂的地方 → 養蜂場

senses.en: the highest point or climax of something
the point in an orbit farthest from the earth

ex.en: The empire reached its apogee under its third emperor.
ex.zh: 這個帝國在第三任皇帝統治下達到巔峰。

root.note: 離地球最遠的點 → 遠地點、巔峰

senses.en: a statement saying that one is sorry
a formal written defense of a belief or action

ex.en: The company issued a public apology for the data leak.
ex.zh: 那家公司為資料外洩公開道歉。

root.note: 為自己開脫的話 → 辯解、道歉

senses.en: the abandonment of a religious or political belief

ex.en: In some countries, apostasy can lead to severe punishment.
ex.zh: 在某些國家，背棄宗教信仰可能遭受嚴厲懲罰。

root.note: 站到別處去 → 叛教

senses.en: a person who abandons a religious or political belief

ex.en: The former member was treated as an apostate by the group.
ex.zh: 那位前成員被團體視為叛徒。

root.note: 站到別處去的人 → 叛教者

senses.en: one of the twelve followers sent by Jesus to spread his teaching
a strong supporter of an idea or cause

ex.en: She became an apostle of healthy eating after her illness.
ex.zh: 生病之後，她成了健康飲食的熱心倡導者。

root.note: 被派出去的人 → 使徒

senses.en: a person who prepared and sold medicines in earlier times; a pharmacist

ex.en: In the village, the apothecary mixed herbs for every illness.
ex.zh: 在村子裡，藥劑師會為各種病痛調配草藥。

root.note: 原指儲藏室 → 管理藥材的人 → 藥劑師

senses.en: the highest point or perfect example of something
the raising of a person to the rank of a god

ex.en: Critics called the film the apotheosis of the director's style.
ex.zh: 影評人說這部電影是導演風格的極致之作。

root.note: 轉變成神 → 神化 → 極致

senses.en: to greatly shock or disgust someone

ex.en: The cruel treatment of the animals will appall anyone who sees the video.
ex.zh: 任何看到影片的人，都會對這些動物遭受的殘忍對待感到震驚。

root.note: 使人臉色發白 → 使驚駭

senses.en: clearly visible or understood; obvious
seeming real but not necessarily so

ex.en: It soon became apparent that no one had read the instructions.
ex.zh: 很快就很明顯了：根本沒人讀過說明書。

root.note: 出現在眼前的 → 明顯的

senses.en: a ghost or ghostlike image of a person
the sudden appearance of something remarkable

ex.en: The guard swore he saw an apparition in the castle hallway.
ex.zh: 守衛發誓他在城堡走廊看到了幽靈。

root.note: 突然出現的東西 → 幽靈

senses.en: to calm or satisfy someone by giving in to their demands

ex.en: The government tried to appease the protesters by lowering fuel prices.
ex.zh: 政府試圖以調降油價來安撫抗議者。

root.note: 使回到和平 → 安撫

senses.en: (of a court) dealing with appeals against earlier decisions

ex.en: The case went to an appellate court after the first verdict.
ex.zh: 第一審判決後，這個案子上訴到了上訴法院。

root.note: 向（上級）呼喊的 → 上訴的

senses.en: a name or title

ex.en: The town earned the appellation "City of Bridges" for its many rivers.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮因為河流眾多，而得到「橋之城」的稱號。

root.note: 用來叫某人的東西 → 名稱

senses.en: to add something to the end of a document or piece of writing

ex.en: Please append a list of sources to your essay.
ex.zh: 請在論文後面附上參考資料清單。

root.note: 掛在後面 → 附加

senses.en: to relate to or belong to

ex.en: These rules appertain only to students living on campus.
ex.zh: 這些規定只適用於住校的學生。

root.note: 被牢牢握在（某範圍）內 → 屬於

senses.en: highly appropriate or relevant

ex.en: Her apposite quotation perfectly summed up the discussion.
ex.zh: 她引用的話非常貼切，完美總結了這場討論。

root.note: 放在正好的地方 → 恰當的

senses.en: (grammar) placing a noun phrase next to another that refers to the same thing

ex.en: In "my brother, the doctor," the second phrase is in apposition to the first.
ex.zh: 在 my brother, the doctor 裡，後面那個片語是前面的同位語。

root.note: 放在旁邊 → 同位語

senses.en: to judge the value, quality, or nature of something

ex.en: An expert will appraise the painting before the auction.
ex.zh: 拍賣前會有專家為這幅畫估價。

root.note: 給定一個價值 → 估價

mn: appraise（估價）和 apprise（通知）很像，別搞混。

senses.en: large or important enough to be noticed

ex.en: The new medicine made no appreciable difference to her symptoms.
ex.zh: 新藥對她的症狀沒有明顯的改善。

root.note: 可以估出價值的 → 可觀的

senses.en: to arrest someone for a crime
to understand or perceive

ex.en: Police managed to apprehend the thief two blocks away.
ex.zh: 警方在兩條街外成功逮捕了小偷。

root.note: 抓住（人或意思）→ 逮捕、理解

senses.en: capable of being understood or perceived

ex.en: The teacher made the difficult theory apprehensible to young students.
ex.zh: 老師讓這個艱深的理論變得連年幼的學生都能理解。

root.note: 可以抓住（意思）的 → 可理解的

senses.en: approval or praise

ex.en: The plan won the approbation of both parents and teachers.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得家長和老師雙方的認可。

root.note: 證明是好的 → 認可

senses.en: suitable or proper in the circumstances
[əˋproprɪˏet] to take something for one's own use, often without permission
[əˋproprɪˏet] to set aside money for a specific purpose

ex.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a job interview at a bank.
ex.zh: 去銀行面試穿牛仔褲並不恰當。

root.note: 變成自己的 → 挪用；適合自己的 → 適當的

senses.en: a bridge or channel built to carry water over long distances

ex.en: The Romans built a stone aqueduct to bring water into the city.
ex.zh: 羅馬人建造了一座石造渡槽，把水引進城裡。

root.note: 引導水的建築 → 導水管

senses.en: of, like, or containing water

ex.en: The salt was dissolved to make an aqueous solution.
ex.zh: 這些鹽被溶解製成水溶液。

root.note: 水的

senses.en: a person who settles a dispute or has final authority
a person whose views on taste or style are respected

ex.en: The magazine sees itself as the arbiter of good taste in fashion.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌自認是時尚品味的權威。

parts.m: judge, witness 裁判者（拉丁文）

root.note: 做裁判的人 → 仲裁者

senses.en: based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason
(of power) used without limits or fairness

ex.en: The deadline seemed arbitrary, since no one could explain why it was chosen.
ex.zh: 這個期限似乎很隨意，因為沒人能解釋為什麼定在那天。

root.note: 全憑裁判者一人決定 → 武斷的

senses.en: to act as an impartial judge to settle a dispute

ex.en: A neutral expert was hired to arbitrate the contract dispute.
ex.zh: 雙方聘請一位中立專家來仲裁這起合約糾紛。

root.note: 擔任裁判 → 仲裁

senses.en: a shady garden shelter formed by trees or climbing plants on a frame

ex.en: We ate lunch under a grape arbor in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園的葡萄藤架下吃午餐。

root.note: 樹木或植物形成的遮蔭 → 藤架

senses.en: living in trees; relating to trees

ex.en: Koalas are arboreal animals that rarely come down to the ground.
ex.zh: 無尾熊是樹棲動物，很少下到地面。

root.note: 樹的 → 樹棲的

senses.en: treelike in size, shape, or branching

ex.en: Some ferns in the rainforest grow to an arborescent height.
ex.zh: 雨林中有些蕨類能長到像樹一樣高。

root.note: 漸漸長成樹的樣子 → 樹狀的

senses.en: a garden where many kinds of trees are grown for study and display

ex.en: The university arboretum has over two thousand kinds of trees.
ex.zh: 這所大學的樹木園裡有超過兩千種樹。

root.note: 種樹的地方 → 樹木園

senses.en: the cultivation and care of trees and shrubs

ex.en: He studied arboriculture and now cares for the city's street trees.
ex.zh: 他學的是樹木栽培，現在負責照顧市區的行道樹。

root.note: 種植樹木 → 樹木栽培

senses.en: a covered passage with arches, often lined with shops
a place with coin-operated games

ex.en: We spent the afternoon playing games at the arcade.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在電玩遊樂場打電動。

root.note: 一連串的拱 → 拱廊

senses.en: the study of human history through digging up and examining ancient remains

ex.en: Advances in archaeology have changed how we view ancient Egypt.
ex.zh: 考古學的進展改變了我們對古埃及的看法。

root.note: 研究古代的學問 → 考古學

senses.en: very old or old-fashioned; no longer in everyday use

ex.en: "Thou" is an archaic word for "you."
ex.zh: thou 是 you 的古老說法。

root.note: 古代的 → 過時的

senses.en: an old word or style that is no longer in common use

ex.en: The poet used "ere" as a deliberate archaism.
ex.zh: 詩人刻意用 ere 這個古語。

root.note: 古代的用語 → 古語

senses.en: an angel of high rank

ex.en: The painting shows the archangel Michael defeating a dragon.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪天使長米迦勒擊敗惡龍。

root.note: 天使中的首領 → 天使長

senses.en: a bishop of the highest rank, in charge of a large area

ex.en: The archbishop led the ceremony in the cathedral.
ex.zh: 大主教在大教堂主持典禮。

root.note: 主教中的首領 → 大主教

senses.en: a senior member of the clergy who assists a bishop

ex.en: The archdeacon visited each parish in the district once a year.
ex.zh: 副主教每年到轄區內的每個教區巡視一次。

root.note: 執事中的首領 → 副主教

senses.en: a perfect or typical example of something
an original model; a recurring symbol or character in literature

ex.en: The wise old mentor is a common archetype in fantasy stories.
ex.zh: 睿智的老導師是奇幻故事中常見的原型角色。

root.note: 最初的模型 → 原型

senses.en: a group of islands

ex.en: The Philippines is an archipelago of more than seven thousand islands.
ex.zh: 菲律賓是由七千多座島嶼組成的群島。

root.note: 原指愛琴海（主要的海），因多島而引申為群島

senses.en: very enthusiastic or passionate

ex.en: She is an ardent supporter of animal rights.
ex.zh: 她是動物權的熱烈支持者。

root.note: 燃燒般的 → 熱烈的

senses.en: great enthusiasm or passion

ex.en: Their ardor for the project faded after the funding was cut.
ex.zh: 經費被刪減後，他們對這個計畫的熱情也消退了。

root.note: 燃燒的感覺 → 熱情

senses.en: having little or no rain; very dry
lacking interest or imagination

ex.en: Few crops can survive in such an arid climate.
ex.zh: 在這麼乾旱的氣候下，很少有作物能存活。

root.note: 乾燥的

senses.en: the highest social class, usually with inherited titles and wealth
government by a small privileged class

ex.en: The French aristocracy lost much of its power after the revolution.
ex.zh: 法國貴族階級在大革命後失去了大部分權力。

root.note: 由最好的人統治 → 貴族統治

senses.en: a member of the aristocracy; a noble

ex.en: The old castle once belonged to a wealthy aristocrat.
ex.zh: 這座古堡曾經屬於一位富有的貴族。

root.note: 最好的統治者 → 貴族

senses.en: a large fleet of warships or other vessels

ex.en: An armada of fishing boats sailed out to rescue the stranded sailors.
ex.zh: 一大批漁船出海營救受困的水手。

root.note: 武裝起來的一群 → 艦隊

senses.en: as much as one can hold in one or both arms

ex.en: She came home with an armful of library books.
ex.zh: 她抱著一大疊圖書館的書回家。

root.note: 一整個手臂的量 → 一抱

senses.en: a place where weapons are stored
a supply of resources available for use

ex.en: The rebels broke into the armory and seized the rifles.
ex.zh: 叛軍闖入軍械庫，奪走了步槍。

root.note: 放武器的地方 → 軍械庫

senses.en: a pleasant, distinctive smell

ex.en: The aroma of fresh coffee filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 現煮咖啡的香味瀰漫整個廚房。

senses.en: to bring someone before a court to answer a criminal charge
to criticize harshly

ex.en: Prosecutors will arraign the suspect on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 檢察官將在週一上午提審這名嫌犯。

root.note: 叫來說清楚道理 → 傳訊

senses.en: to put things in a neat or particular order
to plan or organize something in advance

ex.en: Can you arrange a meeting with the principal for Friday?
ex.zh: 你能幫我安排週五跟校長見面嗎？

root.note: 放進行列中 → 排列

senses.en: a plan or preparation for a future event
the way things are organized or placed
an agreement between people

ex.en: The flower arrangement on the table was beautiful.
ex.zh: 桌上的插花非常漂亮。

root.note: 排列好的東西 → 安排、布置

senses.en: complete; utter (used for something bad)

ex.en: That claim is arrant nonsense, and everyone knows it.
ex.zh: 那個說法根本是一派胡言，大家都知道。

root.note: 原為 errant（遊蕩的），用於 arrant thief（到處作案的賊）→ 十足的

senses.en: (usually arrears) money that is owed and should already have been paid

ex.en: The tenant was three months in arrear with his rent.
ex.zh: 那名房客已經拖欠三個月的房租了。

root.note: 落在後面 → 拖欠

mn: 通常用複數 arrears，片語 in arrears 表示「拖欠」。

senses.en: the act of reaching a place
a person or thing that has just arrived or appeared
senses.zh: 新來的人；新出現的事物

ex.en: The arrival of the train was delayed by heavy snow.
ex.zh: 火車因大雪而延誤抵達。

root.note: 靠岸 → 抵達

senses.en: having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance

ex.en: His arrogant attitude made it hard for him to keep friends.
ex.zh: 他傲慢的態度讓他很難維持友誼。

root.note: 要求別人把好處歸給自己 → 傲慢的

senses.en: to take or claim something without justification

ex.en: The committee tried to arrogate powers that belonged to the council.
ex.zh: 委員會企圖擅取原本屬於理事會的權力。

root.note: 要求歸給自己 → 擅取

senses.en: a well in which water rises by natural pressure without pumping

ex.en: The ranch gets its water from an artesian well that never needs a pump.
ex.zh: 這座牧場的水來自一口自流井，完全不需要抽水機。

root.note: 最早在法國阿圖瓦鑽出的井 → 自流井

senses.en: clever in a crafty or cunning way
showing skill or creative talent

ex.en: The artful salesman convinced her to buy two phones she didn't need.
ex.zh: 那個狡猾的推銷員說服她買了兩支她根本不需要的手機。

root.note: 充滿技巧的 → 巧妙的、狡猾的

senses.en: relating to the legends of King Arthur and his knights

ex.en: The novel retells an Arthurian legend from Guinevere's point of view.
ex.zh: 這部小說從桂妮薇兒的角度重述亞瑟王傳說。

root.note: 亞瑟王的

senses.en: clever tricks used to deceive others
skill or ingenuity

ex.en: She won the argument through honesty, not artifice.
ex.zh: 她靠的是誠實而非詭計贏得這場辯論。

root.note: 用技巧做出來的 → 巧計

senses.en: without deceit; simple and natural
without skill; clumsy

ex.en: The child's artless honesty charmed everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 孩子天真坦率的話讓全桌的人都很喜歡。

root.note: 沒有心機的 → 天真的

senses.en: rising in power or influence
(in the ascendant) a position of growing power

ex.en: The young party is now ascendant after winning several elections.
ex.zh: 這個年輕的政黨連贏數場選舉後，現在正處於上升期。

root.note: 向上爬的 → 上升的

senses.en: the act of rising to a higher position
(the Ascension) the ascent of Jesus into heaven

ex.en: Her ascension to the throne was celebrated across the country.
ex.zh: 全國各地都在慶祝她登基。

root.note: 向上爬 → 上升

senses.en: a climb or movement upward
an upward slope
a rise to a higher status

ex.en: The final ascent to the summit took four hours.
ex.zh: 最後攻頂的那段攀登花了四個小時。

root.note: 向上爬 → 攀登

mn: ascent（上升）和 assent（同意）同音，別搞混。

senses.en: practicing strict self-discipline and avoiding pleasure
a person who lives a life of strict self-denial

ex.en: The monk lived an ascetic life with no possessions but a bowl and a robe.
ex.zh: 那位僧人過著苦行生活，除了一個缽和一件袍子別無長物。

root.note: 嚴格修練的 → 苦行的

senses.en: to regard something as caused by or belonging to someone or something

ex.en: Doctors ascribe his recovery to the new treatment.
ex.zh: 醫生把他的康復歸功於新療法。

root.note: 寫在某人名下 → 歸因於

senses.en: (of reproduction) not involving the joining of male and female cells
without sexual feelings or interest

ex.en: Some plants use asexual reproduction to make copies of themselves.
ex.zh: 有些植物用無性生殖來複製自己。

root.note: 不涉及兩性的 → 無性的

senses.en: very pale because of shock, fear, or illness

ex.en: His face turned ashen when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時，臉色一下子變得慘白。

root.note: 像灰燼一樣的顏色 → 灰白的

senses.en: with suspicion or disapproval
with a sideways glance

ex.en: The old farmers looked askance at the city boy's new ideas.
ex.zh: 老農夫們對這個城市男孩的新點子抱持懷疑的眼光。

mn: 常用片語 look askance at，意思是「用懷疑的眼光看待」。

senses.en: harshness of tone or manner
roughness or harshness of conditions

ex.en: "Sit down," the coach said with some asperity.
ex.zh: 「坐下。」教練語氣有些嚴厲地說。

root.note: 粗糙 → 粗暴

senses.en: a person who hopes to achieve a particular position or goal

ex.en: Each aspirant for the scholarship must write a personal essay.
ex.zh: 每位申請這項獎學金的人都必須寫一篇個人自述。

root.note: 朝著目標喘氣追逐的人 → 有抱負者

senses.en: a hope or ambition to achieve something

ex.en: Her aspiration is to become the first doctor in her family.
ex.zh: 她的志向是成為家族裡第一位醫生。

root.note: 朝著目標呼吸（渴望）→ 抱負

senses.en: to have a strong hope to achieve something

ex.en: Many young athletes aspire to play in the Olympics.
ex.zh: 許多年輕運動員都渴望參加奧運。

root.note: 朝著目標呼吸 → 渴望

senses.en: a person who physically attacks another

ex.en: The victim could not describe her assailant because it was too dark.
ex.zh: 因為太暗，受害者無法描述攻擊她的人。

root.note: 撲向別人的人 → 攻擊者

senses.en: a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons

ex.en: The assassin was caught before he could reach the president.
ex.zh: 刺客在接近總統前就被抓到了。

parts.m: hashish user 吸大麻者（阿拉伯文）

root.note: 源自中世紀一個據說吸食大麻後行刺的教派 → 刺客

senses.en: to murder an important person, usually for political reasons

ex.en: The rebels plotted to assassinate the king during the parade.
ex.zh: 叛軍密謀在遊行時暗殺國王。

root.note: 做刺客做的事 → 暗殺

senses.en: the murder of an important person, usually for political reasons

ex.en: The assassination of the archduke helped start World War I.
ex.zh: 大公遇刺事件促成了第一次世界大戰的爆發。

root.note: 刺客的行為 → 暗殺

senses.en: a test of the quality or purity of a metal or substance
to test the purity or content of something
(old use) to attempt

ex.en: The lab ran an assay to measure how much gold the ore contained.
ex.zh: 實驗室做了化驗，測量礦石的含金量。

root.note: 試一試 → 化驗

senses.en: official agreement or approval
to agree to or approve of something

ex.en: The law cannot take effect without the governor's assent.
ex.zh: 沒有州長的同意，這條法律無法生效。

root.note: 有相同的感覺 → 同意

mn: assent（同意）和 ascent（上升）同音；反義詞是 dissent。

senses.en: to judge the nature, quality, or value of something
to calculate the amount of a tax or fine

ex.en: Engineers came to assess the damage after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，工程師前來評估損害情況。

root.note: 坐在（法官）旁邊協助判斷 → 評估

senses.en: a person who estimates the value of property, often for tax purposes
a person who judges the quality of something, such as exam work

ex.en: The tax assessor visited to estimate the value of our house.
ex.zh: 稅務估價員來估算我們房子的價值。

root.note: 坐在旁邊判斷的人 → 評估員

senses.en: property owned by a person or company that has value
useful or valuable qualities or people

ex.en: The company sold some of its assets to pay off its debts.
ex.zh: 那家公司賣掉部分資產來償還債務。

senses.en: showing great care, attention, and hard work
senses.zh: 勤勉的；刻苦的；一絲不苟的

ex.en: Thanks to her assiduous practice, she played the concerto flawlessly.
ex.zh: 多虧她勤奮練習，這首協奏曲她演奏得完美無瑕。

root.note: 一直坐在工作旁 → 勤勉的

senses.en: a person to whom a right, property, or task is legally transferred

ex.en: The patent was transferred to the assignee after the company was sold.
ex.zh: 公司出售後，這項專利轉讓給了受讓人。

root.note: 被指派（標記）給的人 → 受讓人
